test.command: python -m pytest tests/test_phase5_intraday_runner.py tests/test_source_capture_start.py tests/test_kite_forward_events.py -q; python -m ruff check src/financial_brain/paper/intraday_runner.py tests/test_phase5_intraday_runner.py; python -m mypy src/financial_brain/paper/intraday_runner.py src/financial_brain/ingest/kite_live.py

implemented: Captures a unique source session ID and verifies capture start precedes the earliest decision time.
Persists the capture-start marker before the first market event, with monotonic immutable replay semantics.
Records measured clock skew, clock evidence ID, initial quote-health facts/reasons, and source entitlement evidence with validity windows.
Missing or expired source entitlements are visible and block the capture receipt's entry-eligibility indicator.
Kite forward_events accepts runner/config/receipt together and durably records capture start before calling the quote provider.

Regular intraday run_live accepts the existing ForwardSessionRunner/config/receipt, records the receipt before its first live quote request, and sends later normalized polls to its existing event sink.
When forward event capture is enabled without a valid start receipt and required sinks, the preflight is forced to NO_TRADE and normalized events are suppressed.
blockers: Caller-owned launch configuration must supply the capture runner/config/receipt; no trusted automatic receipt provider is configured.
Clock and entitlement evidence is supplied by callers and is not independently authenticated.
No actual observed source-capture session has been produced.
